summary: @actualham and @cathieleblanc This discussion actually started as I am trying to think about the easiest way to make my workflow around my #oer materials while also building in the metadata to make it both more remixable and trackable across the web for others to use. I am at the limits of my knowledge so it's a fun place to be.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
@actualham and @cathieleblanc This discussion actually started as I am trying to think about the easiest way to make my workflow around my #oer materials while also building in the metadata to make it both more remixable and trackable across the web for others to use.

I am at the limits of my knowledge so it's a fun place to be.
